On escalation in Hormuz:

Under the MOU, Tehran agreed to facilitate safe/innocent passage through the Strait of Hormuz, but with coordination. In Iran’s view, that doesn’t give the U.S. the right to unilaterally escort or organize commercial shipping.

Tehran’s message is clear: the Strait is open but not on U.S. terms.

posts.text:
I told @TIME that the funeral of Ayatollah Khamenei is far more than a religious ceremony.

The message is that while the leader is gone, the Islamic Republic’s institutions remain intact and the state endures.

It is an opportunity to reassure both domestic and regional audiences that the transition is under control.

It’s the biggest political ritual that Iran has seen since the funeral of the first Leader Ayatollah Khamenei.
